candidates.name: increase_collision_penalty_scale
candidates.hypothesis: Increasing collision penalties will reduce contact rates during racing.
candidates.rationale: Higher penalties for collisions should discourage aggressive interactions that lead to contact.

candidates.name: enhance_overtake_bonus
candidates.hypothesis: Boosting the overtake bonus will encourage overtaking behavior without causing excessive contact.
candidates.rationale: A higher bonus for clean overtakes promotes strategic passing while minimizing blocking.

candidates.name: reduce_hook_contact_penalty
candidates.hypothesis: Reducing the hook contact penalty will allow for more aggressive passing without invoking severe penalties.
candidates.rationale: A less severe penalty for hook contact may promote more competitive behavior while maintaining safety.
